name: Ritsumeikan University
description: Ritsumeikan University is a private university founded in 1900, with campuses in Kyoto, Shiga (Biwako-Kusatsu) and Osaka (Ibaraki). It is one of Japan's largest universities and teaches several undergraduate majors fully in English.
whyIncluded: Ritsumeikan's English-taught undergraduate programmes accept GCE A-Levels and the IB, and Singapore citizens may be exempt from English test scores.

livingCosts.summary: Ritsumeikan's own monthly cost-of-living table for international students (from its co-op's 2025 student survey): university accommodation, food, transport, books, entertainment, phone and sundries, 12 months a year. Excludes tuition and insurance.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Ritsumeikan University English-medium undergraduate admissions 'Cost of Living' page, figures attributed to the FY2025 Student Life Survey Report by Ritsumeikan Co-op (ranges across its Kyoto, Osaka Ibaraki and Biwako-Kusatsu campuses; midpoints used): housing = 'University Accommodations' 39,000-65,000 (midpoint 52,000; the page does not say whether utilities are included); food 29,500-32,200 (midpoint 30,850); transport 4,700-5,800 (midpoint 5,250); personal = books & supplies 600-2,100 (1,350) + entertainment 13,000-16,500 (14,750) + telecommunications 3,700-4,200 (3,950) + miscellaneous 1,100-4,800 (2,950) = 23,000. The page's own total is 133,600-144,700. Health insurance is not listed on the page (National Health Insurance, roughly 2,000/month elsewhere, is therefore not included); tuition excluded. USD conversions on the page ignored.

programmes.name: Graduate School of International Relations (Master's)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for 2027 entrants to the 2-year master's, the same for international students. The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee, paid in year 1. Fees may rise with prices.
programmes.notes: Ritsumeikan 'Student-Fee Policy for AY 2027 and Beyond and AY 2027 Tuition and Other Fees' (council document): graduate master's AY 2027 tuition spring ¥449,400 + fall ¥449,400 = ¥898,800 (years 1-2). Entrance fee ¥200,000 standard (waived for some internal or joint-degree routes). The document says master's tuition rises ¥40,000 from AY 2026, then follows a price index (capped at ¥30,000 a year), so not cohort-locked. No earlier-year table found. Tried 2026-10-13: no master's fee table for 2024-2026 entrants found (the graduate school's eng202X_gakuhi.pdf fee sheets were not reachable; the AY 2026 readmission guidelines give readmission rates only), so no history. Tried 2026-10-13: Ritsumeikan graduate school guides 2025-2027 (大学院案内) as text omit the 学費 table; still no 2024-2026 master's figure. Round 3 (2026-10-13): the Ritsumeikan Trust disclosure page (ritsumeikan-trust.jp/publicinfo/disclosure/data/, section 8-1) links per-cohort graduate fee PDFs '学費【立命館大学＿大学院＿2024年度入学者】' (file.jsp?id=578988), 2025 (id=627471) and 2026 (id=661898); they hold the needed figures (some schools have separate 1回生/2回生 rates), but the text extracted by the fetch tool loses the table layout so amounts cannot be matched to graduate schools reliably; no rows added, and a person reading the PDFs could fill 2024-2026. 2025 row (2026-10-13, rung 1): Ritsumeikan '学費およびその他納付金について' for 2025 entrants ('2025年度入学者に適用する授業料は、修了するまで以下の表のとおり') gives the row '国際関係研究科（GIRPを除く）' 授業料 405,800 per semester, 年次計 811,600 (1st and 2nd year alike), and 入学金 200,000. (GIRP, the English-taught programme, is a separate row at 974,000.) 2026 row (2026-10-13, rung 2): the 2026 entrants' graduate fee document ('2026年度大学院入学者学費', https://www.ritsumei.ac.jp/file.jsp?id=505239, same table as ritsumeikan-trust.jp file.jsp?id=661898) gives 418,000 per semester / 836,000 a year and 入学金 200,000 for the standard humanities and social-science master's rows. The extracted text separates labels from amounts, so the pairing was checked: every row that was 811,600 in the 2025 entrants' table (which pairs this school with 811,600 explicitly) is 836,000 in 2026 and no other nearby amount appears; Business Administration, which shares this rate, is listed by JPSS at ¥836,000 explicitly for 'April 2026 entrants' (https://www.jpss.jp/ja/grad/362/994/); and the council document's 2027 rule (2026 entrants' tuition + ¥40,000, then a price-index rise capped at ¥30,000) gives (836,000 + 40,000) x ~1.026 = 898,800, the published 2027 figure. 2024 still unfilled (2026-10-13): JPSS's IR page (updated 20 Aug 2024) gives ¥788,000 for programmes other than GIRP but states no fee year, and no second independent source was found. Round 5 (2026-10-13): the 2024 entrants' graduate fee PDF (学費【立命館大学＿大学院＿2024年度入学者】, ritsumeikan-trust.jp file.jsp?id=578988), read with pdftotext -layout, gives 国際関係研究科 国際関係学プログラム 春学期 394,000 + 秋学期 394,000 = 788,000 (1st and 2nd year; GIRP separate at 945,600) and 入学金 200,000; 2024 row added.
